dataset_title: Recorded offences by local government area
native_record_key: Table 01 year + year-ending month + LGA name
record_granularity: LGA rolling-year offence count and rate at quarterly release
completeness_rule: Select latest by-LGA XLSX resource from DataVic catalog, validate Table 01 headers and parse every row. Do not use suburb-level data or claim an individual incident location.

admission_evidence.native_record_key: Table 01 year + year-ending month + LGA name
admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Table 01 header and all rows validated against selected resource

notes: Reviewed 2026-10-01: DataVic dataset and catalog state CC BY 4.0 and quarterly publication. Latest official by-LGA XLSX Table 01 has 810 rolling-year rows across 81 source area names and ten June year endings, covering 2016-07-01 onward. There is no official numeric LGA code or geography vintage, so preserve source names and unresolved boundary references; current boundaries must not be inferred. Two metrics per row represent a rolling 12-month offence count and a rate per 100,000 population, not individual incidents or a single-quarter count. A valid nonfuture HTTP Last-Modified value orders file corrections and is never substituted for publication or incident time. Project quota six HTTP requests per UTC day is a conservative Melens cap, not a published provider entitlement; maxAttempts=1 for catalog and workbook. One daily check consumes two requests. No article text or person-level data is collected. Attribution: Crime Statistics Agency Victoria, Data tables - Recorded offences, CC BY 4.0; the application extracts Table 01 and normalizes units and null markers.
